Identification: boy, 10 years and 6 months, brought by parents for evaluation in a medical genetics outpatient clinic.

Main complaint: seizures and learning delay.

Current disease history: parents report that seizures began during the first days of life, in the nursery. Throughout childhood, he has had various types of seizures: episodes of rhythmic and repetitive limb shaking, episodes of arm and neck rigidity, and generalized tonic-clonic seizures. In early years, the mother noticed that he took significantly longer than other children to sit, walk, interact, and play. To date, he does not speak any words.

History: attended school with special pedagogical support; neuropsychological assessment revealed mild intellectual disability.

Complementary tests: previous EEG showed hypsarrhythmia. Serum carnitine level below reference value. Urinary organic acids with increased excretion of 3-hydroxyisovaleric acid and 3-methylcrotonylglycine. Enzymatic assay in fibroblast culture demonstrated reduced activity of 3-methylcrotonyl-CoA carboxylase.

translation:
Identification: boy, 10 years and 6 months, brought by parents for evaluation in a medical genetics outpatient clinic.

Chief complaint: seizures and learning delay.

History of present illness: The parents report that the seizures began in the first few days of life, in the nursery. Throughout childhood, he presented with several types of seizures: episodes of rhythmic and repetitive shaking of the limbs, episodes of stiffening of the arms and neck, and generalized tonic-clonic seizures. In one of the decompensations, he became unresponsive to any stimulus, admitted to ICU, in a coma. In the first years, the mother noticed that he took much longer than other children to sit, walk, interact, and play. He still does not speak any words.

Past medical history: Followed in school with pedagogical support; neuropsychological evaluation revealed mild intellectual disability.

Additional tests: Previous EEG with hipsarhythmia. Serum carnitine level below the reference value. Urinary organic acids with increased excretion of 3-hydroxy-isovaleric acid and 3-methylcrotonylglycine. Enzymatic assay in fibroblast culture showed reduced activity of 3-methylcrotonyl-CoA carboxylase.

Complementary exams: Patient-brought ophthalmological evaluation shows reduced visual acuity and report of rod and cone dystrophy.
